💡 Remember before you play

  • Digraph: two letters, one sound — sh (ship), ch (chip), th (thin), ck (duck), ng (ring), wh (whale).
  • Blend: two letters, two sounds — fr (frog), st (stop), nd (hand), mp (lamp).
  • Magic e is silent and the vowel says its name: cap → cape, kit → kite.
  • Long a: a_e, ai, ay, eigh · Long e: ee, ea, y, ey · Long i: i_e, igh, y, ie · Long o: o_e, oa, ow · Long u: u_e, ue, ew, ui.
  • oo has two sounds: moon / book. er, ir, ur sound the same: her, bird, fur.
